body:
Please provide more detailed replication steps for this, there might be many different conditions here

Also please try a supported version like 4.4.1, to ensure this is still relevant

> Please provide more detailed replication steps

The problem is - i dont know what happens. I see in logs `WARNING: ObjectDB instances leaked`, trying to get addition info, and got this. Its happens in big project, i dont know where to look and i cant even get info on nodes.
I'd suggest asking in the [forums](https://forum.godotengine.org/) for help identifying this, we can't really do much without steps to reproduce this

I'm able to reproduce something like this in my own game (`v4.6.beta2` and `v4.5-stable` on Windows 10 using Git Bash). ``` ERROR: 5 RID allocations of type 'P12GodotShape3D' were leaked at exit. ERROR: 1 RID allocations of type 'N26RendererEnvironmentStorage11EnvironmentE' were leaked at exit. ERROR: 11 RID allocations of type 'PN13RendererDummy14TextureStorage12DummyTextureE' were leaked at exit. ERROR: 1 RID allocations of type 'N13RendererDummy9DummyMeshE' were leaked at exit. ERROR: 1 RID allocations of type 'N13RendererDummy15MaterialStorage11DummyShaderE' were leaked at exit. ERROR: 4 RID allocations of type 'PN18TextServerAdvanced12FontAdvancedE' were leaked at exit. WARNING: ObjectDB instances leaked at exit (run with --verbose for details). at: cleanup (core/object/object.cpp:2611) Leaked instance: GDScriptNativeClass:9223372042642915641 - Reference count: 2 [.... abridged ...] Leaked instance: Image:9223373807354452252 - Reference count: 1 Hint: Leaked instances typically happen when nodes are removed from the scene tree (with `remove_child()`) but not freed (with `free()` or `queue_free()`). ERROR: 181 resources still in use at exit. at: clear (core/io/resource.cpp:805) Resource still in use: res://elements/font.png::Image_sgntb (Image) Resource still in use: res://elements/font.png (FontFile) Resource still in use: res://utils.gd (GDScript) Resource still in use: res://data/dialog_speakers.gd (GDScript) Resource still in use: res://elements/dialog_choice.gd (GDScript) Resource still in use: res://elements/dialog_line.gd (GDScript) [.... abridged ...] Resource still in use: res://addons/nklbdev.importality/export/_.gd (GDScript) Orphan StringName: VisualShaderNodeTextureSDF (static: 1, total: 2) [.... abridged ...] Orphan StringName: ProgressBar (static: 1, total: 2) Orphan StringName: res://elements/tool_compass.gd (static: 0, total: 5) StringName: 2315 unclaimed string names at exit. ./scripts/build.sh: line 18: 4014 Segmentation fault "$GODOT" --headless --verbose --export-release 'Web' web/index.html ``` I was able to delete and massage files until I have only a handful. I think I could make it more minimal, but it's as far as I got this time. Edit: Originally I had a non-minimal repro, here's a minimal repro. [heap-use-after-free-bug-2.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/24638102/heap-use-after-free-bug-2.zip) When I remove any one of these connections or items, the bug is not reproducible anymore. Including assigning `transform` in character.tscn.
